name: Family Tree Planting – Hampton Loade – 27 October
description: Free hands-on family tree planting with demonstrations and all planting materials supplied. Runs 27 and 28 October, 09:30–12:30. Booking is essential. Suitable for families with children over 4.
accessibility: Contact the National Trust to discuss access requirements. There is a short walk from the car park to the planting site; a portable toilet is available.

name: Shropshire Music Awards 2026
description: Annual county-wide awards celebrating Shropshire musicians, venues and music-industry achievement, with live music and a public ticket sale.

name: Halloween at Telford Ice Rink
description: Halloween disco at Telford Ice Rink with themed music, decorations and Halloween surprises on the ice.

name: Bonfire & Fireworks Night – Weston Park
description: Weston Park Bonfire & Fireworks Night with a bonfire, funfair, street food and two fireworks displays. Gates open at 3pm, bonfire is lit at 5pm, fireworks are at 6pm and 7:30pm, and the event closes at 9pm. Tickets must be bought in advance. Lowest paid early-bird ticket is £7 for children aged 4–14; under-4s are free.
accessibility: Accessible parking is available for Blue Badge holders and accessible toilets are provided.
parking_transport: Access is by car only; pedestrian admission is not permitted. Parking is on grass car parks and visitors must add a free car pass when booking. The car park is approximately a 10–15 minute walk from the event area.

name: Santa & Mrs Claus: Festive Fun at Hoo Zoo
description: Festive Hoo Zoo event with Christmas craft, Winter Wonderland, a meeting with Santa, a small gift, and a Mrs Claus/Head Elf singalong and storytime. Full zoo admission is included. Quiet sessions are offered on Wednesdays and Thursdays with reduced noise and no singalong.
source_name: Hoo Zoo and Dinosaur World / Visit Telford

name: Telford Festive Gardens – 10 December
venue: Chelsea & Maxell Gardens, Telford Town Park
description: Illuminated North Pole-themed festive trail through Chelsea & Maxell Gardens with music, light and projections. Step-free trail with gradual hills and mixed terrain.
accessibility: Trail is step free, but includes gradual hills and mixed terrain.
